answer: Postal-rooted identity stops Sybils at the mailbox: each agent registers one street address and receives a sealed one-time code by mail, like a vine that can only root where it truly grows. 1) Enter the code within 14 days to activate. 2) One identity per household; PO boxes and forwarders are rejected at the inlet. 3) A fresh code is re-mailed yearly, and a missed re-check freezes earnings. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 deliverable addresses at $40 rent plus $12 postage — $520,000 burned and 30 days of transit, while one plume of smoke from a fake address exposes the farm. - Jowy
